value.headline: California Early Voting 2026: Ballot Returns Down 25%
value.claim: CA returns nearly 25% below the same point of 2022: 1.67M by Oct 20 vs 2.22M (Civiq data)
value.cmp: same calendar point, 2022 (source Civiq, not opened)
value.evidence: PDI received-date data: 2026 1,861,646 at E-14 vs 2022 1,665,254 (+11.8%); at E-11 2,757,613 vs 2,343,341 (+17.7%) [V/M]. UF/SOS 2.94M by the 10/24 report [V]. The article itself concedes it says nothing about final turnout.

rows.source: Parriva: California Early Voting 2026: Ballot Returns Down 25%
rows.note: The verdict is our like-for-like reading of the claim (grade I); the evidence cites its own grades.

value.headline: Republicans Show Gains In California Amid Trump's Massive War Chest
value.claim: Against 2022 the D share of CA returns is down 0.98 pts and the R share up 1.16 pts; D up 1.09 vs 2024
value.cmp: 2022 and 2024 benchmarks, share of returned ballots
value.evidence: PDI E-11: D-R +21.2 (2026) vs +22.3 (2022) vs +19.2 (2024) [M]. Holds on raw share; but CA registration moved R (D-R registration gap 23.0 -> 20.1, 2022 -> 2026 [V]), so relative to registration 2026 returns are about 1.8 pts MORE Democratic than 2022 [M]. The headline "Republicans ahead" is not supported: D lead in returns is about 21 pts.

rows.source: Conservative Brief (citing @E_DataGuy): Republicans Show Gains In California Amid Trump's Massive War Chest
rows.note: The verdict is our like-for-like reading of the claim (grade I); the evidence cites its own grades.
